'''''Hymenophyllum wilsonii''''', the '''Wilson's filmy-fern''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is a small, fragile, perennial [[Leptosporangiate fern|leptosporangiate]] [[fern]] which forms large dense colonies from creeping rhizomes.

==Distribution==
Confined to western Europe (Britain, Ireland, France, Norway, Spain and The Faeroes) and [[Macaronesia]].
